checks.exercise: Bilateral bodyweight step calf raise with heel drop below step, distinct from floor calf raise.
checks.equipment: Actual stable step supports forefeet; no weights or phantom handles visible.
checks.setup: Upright trunk, stable knees; both feet and full body visible. Step and floor at separate heights; heels clear step edge.
checks.hands: Open relaxed hands at sides, no held equipment.
checks.feet: Forefoot geometry constrained to step top across 481 samples; toe bone adjustment <0.08 and skin drift <0.1 while heels rise >1.2. Foot closeup and side previews show plantarflexion, no whole-body sliding.
checks.movement: Both encoded 32-frame sheets reviewed; native 192-frame decode and mobile Edge play/seek/loop passed.

kinematics.units: model world units; body height approximately 17

playback.scope: Local MP4 in mobile Edge emulation, not app or physical device

limitations: Mannequin/barefeet style. Real app/device not tested. Minor toe skin drift recorded in kinematics; bone pivot receives small skin-weight contact correction. Unassisted balance variant. Catalog squat instructions need root correction.
